name: zinc acetate
uses: Uses Poison Ivy, Oak, Sumac Protectant
otcwarn: Warnings For external use only - When using this product do not get into eyes If contact occurs, rinse eyes thoroughly with water Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens Symptoms last more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days Keep out of reach of children If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
